description: Team 8 from Miva Open University, Abuja. We’re building Miva FireLens, an interactive platform that merges NASA MODIS and VIIRS fire data to help responders spot and track wildfires faster. I’m Victor, product designer with 10 years in tech; we also have a software engineer building the prototype. Join us to ship real impact with NASA data. Looking for: GIS/remote sensing or data science (Python, NASA FIRMS), and map/front-end dev skills.
